definitions.eligible: Required miss with majority coverage, majority right normal axis, and majority of covered pixels hitting extra blocks.
definitions.majority_pair: One exact reference unit face and one matching outward face of one extra cube must jointly own >50% of the target covered pixels.
definitions.panel: At least three face-connected target positions on the same recorded wall surface with a common signed extra depth. Tangent tolerances use Manhattan distance in blocks.
definitions.signed_depth: Extra coordinate minus missing reference coordinate dotted with outward surface normal. Positive means extra plane nearer the camera.
definitions.interpretation: Reference-only count of recognizable wrong panels, with each required target and each extra counted once per image per variant. Variants overlap. This does not establish which corrections source-image inference could select.
